incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx error rate on inference-prod (rule: high_inference_errors). Triggered at 2026-07-02T02:45:45Z
ben.trimble: oncall here, looking now. any customer-facing impact?
alice.kuhn: seeing spike in 5xxs from /v1/generate, correlated with model=redwood-7b-embed on a couple of nodes
ben.trimble: thanks. running quick aggregate -> `sum by (instance)(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m]))`
ben.trimble: one GPU host (gpu-12) has sustained 5xxs, p95 latency up too. spreading requests to other pool temporarily
cara.observability: added temporary mute for noisy alert (rule id 1204) for 15m :mute:
ben.trimble: scaling up dedicated pool and draining gpu-12 from rotation now. deploy-bot: Traffic shift started; 4 of 6 replicas healthy
dan.wu: I see OOM logs on gpu-12 around the time. looks like KV cache growth + long sequences -> oom kills
ben.trimble: good find. mitigation: 1) drain node, 2) revert recent rollout of quantized-8bit variant? did we deploy anything recent?
elaine-prod: no product rollout. infra change: batcher config tweak at 02:30 (reduce max_batch_size from 256->512) to improve throughput for a partner job
alice.kuhn: that batcher change matches timeline. large customer requests started hitting and blew past memory assumptions.
ben.trimble: reverting batcher change now to 256. deploy-bot: batcher config rollback completed, new config active on 4 hosts
cara.observability: error rate trending down to baseline. will unmute alert in 10m and add follow-up tuning
ben.trimble: filing quick incident ticket INC-789 and will run a short post-incident retro. assigning followups: @cara to tweak alert rule and dashboard, @dan to add OOM guard to autoscaler, @alice to run model workload simulation for prefix caching
cara.observability: proposed alert rule tweak (prom style):
```
# old (noisy)
ALERT HighInferenceErrors
IF increase(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m]) > 0.02
FOR 1m

# proposed
ALERT HighInferenceErrors_Safe
IF sum by (cluster)(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[2m])) > 0.5
AND histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 1.5
FOR 3m
```
ben.trimble: I like combining absolute count and p95 latency. reduces false positives from low-traffic noisy customers
dan.wu: PR ready for autoscaler OOM guard -> #456, includes max_kv_size check and backpressure signal to batcher
cara.observability: starting a new Grafana dashboard for the retro: draft link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/ZX9x1/inference-incident-retro
car a.observability: planning panels: 1) Golden signals overview (rate/latency/errors/saturation), 2) per-model 95/99 latency, 3) per-host GPU mem and OOM events, 4) batcher queue depth + batch sizes, 5) traffic routing/instance rollouts drilldown
ben.trimble: can you add a panel that drills into tokenization queue latency and kv cache size per model? that's where the blowup was
cara.observability: yup. also adding an annotation stream for config changes + deploy events so we can line up timing
elaine-prod: can we add customer impact summary panel? show top 5 customers by failed requests during window
cara.observability: added a table panel idea that picks out top client_ids by 5xx count, will include in draft
alice.kuhn: for retro, we should also capture suggested threshold adjustments per rule and link to PRs. I'm adding a section in INC-789 ticket
ben.trimble: handoff: I'm on call for next 30m, then @alice.kuhn will take main investigation for the retro tomorrow at 09:00 PT. leaving notes in INC-789
dan.wu: quick note: we should not fully revert batcher change permanently. propose: keep 256 but add adaptive max based on mem pressure + per-customer rate caps
ben.trimble: agreed. put proposal in INC-789 and schedule design review with infra team.
cara.observability: follow-up tasks in checklist: [ ] update alert rule (PR #457) [ ] dashboard panels added (dash id ZX9x1) [ ] annotate config change timeline [ ] run sim for prefix KV growth [ ] autoscaler OOM guard merged (#456)
ben.trimble: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. unmuting alert now and marking incident as mitigated for paging. Retrospective invites -> calendar event INC-789-retro on Friday 09:00 PT
incident-bot: Incident INC-789 created and linked to thread. Priority: P2.
deploy-bot: healthcheck: inference-prod back to healthy, error rate within SLOs
alice.kuhn: leaving handoff notes in the ticket and adding the sim config. will pick up retro tomorrow.
cara.observability: will push dashboard PR after adding the customer-impact panel. expect PR today EOD.
ben.trimble: thanks all. closing thread for live mitigation, please continue follow-ups in INC-789 and dashboard PRs.
